title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_impetuous_peter_by_ellen_g_white_83lr1 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_impetuous_peter_by_ellen_g_white_83lr1' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package can lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to potential persistent control by attackers, full remediation may require additional measures such as rotating all secrets from a clean system.
